title: fix(app-shell): the form designer type tag names the type as the picker does (objectui#13148)
body:
Fixes #13148

Clause-②: no

## What changed

The Studio form designer's field card (`SortableField` in `ObjectFormDesigner.tsx`) rendered the field's spec type id as its type tag, so a Picklist field read "Status SELECT" while the type menu and the inspector's Type control called it "Picklist". The tag now reads the type's display name through `fieldTypeName`, a new internal helper beside the field-type catalog (`views/metadata-admin/previews/fieldTypeName.ts`, not exported from the package): the catalog's `engine.fieldType.ID` row for a type the catalog lists, the type itself for one it does not.

- `select` reads "Picklist", `lookup` "Lookup", `user` "User", `date` "Date"; zh-CN reads the zh rows (`select` reads 下拉选择).
- `FieldControlPreview` and the wide-widget span (`isWideFieldType(toFormFieldType(type))`) still key on the spec id, unchanged.
- No export, prop, accept set or language-pack key moves: the names are the designer's existing `engine.fieldType` rows.

## Mechanism hypotheses, measured

- **H1 (the producer): holds, with one correction.** The type picker (`FieldTypePicker`, its rows and its trigger), the inspector (`ObjectFieldInspector`'s `typeMetaLabel`; its Type control is the picker) and the metadata canvas (`ObjectFormCanvas`'s `typeLabel`) all index `FIELD_TYPE_META` by the raw type and read `engine.fieldType.ID` with ID the meta's id. There is no alias step: the catalog's keys are the spec's `FieldType` ids, and `lookup`, `master_detail`, `user` and `radio` each have their own row ("Lookup", "Master-Detail", "User", "Radio"). A type with no meta: the canvas shows the raw id, the inspector's options heading the raw id, the picker the raw id flagged as not found.
- **H2 (was the spec spelling deliberate?): no, the comment described the variable.** It was written by the objectui#4838 change (`ca2b4096e`), whose question was the spec spelling versus the widget id (`field:markdown`); that card and its comments rule on `FormField.type`, not on the hint. objectui#12451 (`68c9b4008`) specifies "a 10 px uppercase type tag" and names no content. Its reference artboard (`docs/design/studio-redesign/data-form.html`) carries mock tag words ("Select", "Textarea", "Autonumber") with no prose choosing a vocabulary, and that folder's README says the card wins where the two disagree. So the comment is rewritten, and the objectui#4838 pin that asserted the card contains `markdown` is rewritten to its real intent: the widget id never reaches the card.
- **H3 (fix shape): holds.** The lookup was module-local in `ObjectFormCanvas` and inline in the picker and the inspector, so the move is one internal helper beside `field-types.ts`; no second mapping. It reads own keys only, so an inherited key (`toString`) is an unlisted type, not a catalog row.
- **Upper case: kept.** objectui#12451's design spec draws the tag as "a 10 px uppercase type tag". The tag's text is now exactly the picker's string ("Picklist"), drawn in capitals, so it reads PICKLIST on screen; zh is unaffected by case. The card's complaint is the vocabulary (SELECT names a type nothing else in Studio shows), and dropping `uppercase` would reopen objectui#12451's design, which is outside this card. If the seat reads the card's "Picklist" as including the case, the change is the one `uppercase` class on the tag span.
- **H4 (controls): holds**, see the tests.
- **H5 (acceptance and ablation): holds**, see the tests.

## Tests

New `ObjectFormDesigner.typeName-13148.test.tsx`:

- en-US: the Status (select), Owner (user), Account (lookup) and Close Date (date) cards each read the name the type picker's trigger shows for that type, the picker rendered beside them, so the pin is "the two agree" rather than a copy of the table; no card reads its spec id in either case.
- zh-CN: the select card reads the picker's zh name, which is the zh row and differs from the en one.
- Every catalog type reads its own `engine.fieldType` row, and for each, `col-span-full` still equals `isWideFieldType(toFormFieldType(id))`.
- CONTROL: an unlisted type (`legacy_widget`) is shown as itself; `fieldTypeName('toString')` is `toString`.
- The select, search and date skeletons, the label, the required star, and the selected (`text-primary`) and unselected (`text-muted-foreground`) tag colours.

Updated: `ObjectFormDesigner.cards-12451.test.tsx` (the selected tag is found by its display name) and `ObjectFormDesigner.test.tsx` (the objectui#4838 pin, see H2).

Ablation, at `20cabbdd5`: `{typeName}` replaced by `{type}` through objectstack's `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` in wrap mode, under the verify lock. Mutation landed (anchor 1 to 0, blob `ec593613edf9` to `863b8faf5942`). The three files read **6 failed, 19 passed (25)**: four of the five 13148 cases (all but the unlisted-type CONTROL, which stayed green), the objectui#12451 selected-tag case and the objectui#4838 markdown case. Restore proven: blob equals HEAD (`ec593613edf9`) and `git diff HEAD` is empty. No build leg: the tests import the designer from source. The skeleton/colour case was titled CONTROL at the time; `90def928d` drops that title, since its selected-colour half finds the tag by name and so needs the fix.

Run on head `90def928d`:

- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/`: Test Files 224 passed (224), Tests 1598 passed (1598).
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check`: exit 0, after `turbo run build --filter='@object-ui/app-shell^...'` (28 of 28 tasks); `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --listFiles` lists the new test, both edited tests and the helper.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell lint`: exit 0, 0 errors.
- `pnpm check:new-line-citations` 0 (0 new citations), `pnpm check:control-bytes` 0, `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` 0, `node scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs` 0, `pnpm check:i18n-keys` 0, `pnpm check:i18n-drift` 0.

Not measured: a browser screenshot of the running console. The DOM text is pinned against the rendered picker, and the tag's classes are unchanged.

## Acceptance notes

- `ObjectFormCanvas` (`typeLabel`), `FieldTypePicker` and `ObjectFieldInspector` keep their own spelling of the same `engine.fieldType.ID` lookup. Folding them into `fieldTypeName` is a no-behaviour refactor outside this card's file surface. Carrier: none.
- `ObjectFormCanvas` and `FieldTypePicker` test catalog membership with `FIELD_TYPE_META[type]` and `type in FIELD_TYPE_META`, which an inherited key (`toString`) passes. No spec type is such a key, so no author reaches it. Noted, not filed.
- The artboard's mock tag words (see H2) differ from the shipped names; the artboard is not updated here.
